name: FCC 335 (Hubble)
blurb: FCC 335, an elliptical galaxy in the Fornax Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: fcc335-hubble
story: FCC 335 is an elliptical galaxy, one of 43 early-type galaxies Hubble imaged in the Fornax Cluster to study how a cluster environment shapes its members.

claims.text: FCC 335 is an elliptical galaxy observed by the ACS Fornax Cluster Survey
FCC 335 is also ESO 359-G02, type E
The ACS Fornax Cluster Survey imaged 43 early-type galaxies in the Fornax Cluster with Hubble
The survey was designed to study the role of environment
